business_problem: As Trustly started growing rapidly, the fintech company wanted to modernize its data analytics capabilities and become more data driven.
solution_summary: Learn how Trustly, a global leader in open-banking payments, scaled to support growth by modernizing data analytics using Amazon QuickSight. As Trustly started growing rapidly, the fintech company wanted to modernize its data analytics capabilities and become more data driven. When its previous analytics solution could no longer handle the company’s increasing volume of data, Trustly looked to Amazon Web Services (AWS) for an alternative. Using Amazon QuickSight , which powers data-driven organizations with unified business intelligence at scale, Trustly increased productivity and scalability, reduced costs by an estimated 50 percent, and empowered users to independently generate insights. Using QuickSight, Trustly has access to its entire dataset from a single pane of glass, giving users a comprehensive view of data. Source data enters the Trustly workflow through its application services, stored or indexed in Amazon Redshift, and delivered through Amazon QuickSight, Amazon Q.
